title: Adjunct Lecturer in Public Policy
bio: Brian R. Iammartino, CFA is an Adjunct Lecturer in Public Policy at the Harvard Kennedy School, where he specializes in teaching and research on public and non-profit financial management, state and local budgeting, and urban policy.
research_interests: Public Finance Cities & Communities Business & Regulation
